module.purpose: NestJS service in the atoms module that encapsulates email verification workflows for the v2 API. It wraps platform-library verification logic (sending verification codes, verifying codes authenticated or unauthenticated, checking whether verification is required) and manages a user's verified emails, including team-wide verified email resolution and secondary email management backed by AtomsRepository and TeamsRepository.
module.summary: VerificationAtomsService is an injectable service providing email verification operations. It delegates core verification logic to functions from @calcom/platform-libraries: checkEmailVerificationRequired, verifyCodeUnAuthenticated, verifyCodeAuthenticated, and sendEmailVerificationByCode. It translates raw library errors (e.g. 'invalid_code', 'BAD_REQUEST') into NestJS BadRequestException or UnauthorizedException with user-facing messages. The getVerifiedEmails method resolves the set of verified emails for either a team (fetching team member emails plus their secondary emails via TeamsRepository) or an individual user (primary plus secondary emails via AtomsRepository), normalizing emails by stripping OAuth client-id suffixes. addVerifiedEmail validates that an email is not already used and adds it as a secondary email for a user. A helper, removeClientIdFromEmail, strips the '+clientId' segment from the local part of an email address.
module.businessContext: Serves Cal.com's scheduling platform by ensuring users verify their email addresses before certain actions. Correct email verification prevents impersonation and enforces trust in booking-related communications. Failure would allow unverified emails or break team-based verification flows.
